expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply says it clicked Load report in headless Chromium and 'The page threw this error... Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12', and it identifies this as a SyntaxError from JSON.parse.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');` at app.html:5 and says 'The JSON string has no closing `}`.'
